_readme: Companies building or financing U.S. data centers. slug links to the companies array in data/projects.json. aliases are matched as whole words against headlines to count news mentions (case sensitive). type is one of: Hyperscaler, AI Lab, GPU Cloud, Developer, Colocation, Investor, Energy, Hardware.

companies.name: Amazon Web Services
companies.summary: The largest cloud provider. Builds and runs its own campuses for AWS regions, with the biggest U.S. clusters in Northern Virginia, Ohio and Oregon, and new AI campuses such as Project Rainier in Indiana.

companies.name: Microsoft
companies.summary: Runs Azure regions across the country and is building Fairwater, a family of very large AI datacenters starting in Wisconsin and Atlanta. Also leases heavily from developers.

companies.name: Google
companies.summary: Owns and operates most of its own campuses, from long-running sites in Iowa, Oregon and South Carolina to new builds in Oklahoma, Indiana, Missouri and Arkansas.

companies.name: Meta
companies.summary: Builds its own campuses for Facebook, Instagram and AI training. Its newest are gigawatt-scale AI clusters: Prometheus in Ohio and Hyperion in Louisiana.

companies.name: Oracle
companies.summary: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is the cloud operator for most Stargate sites, renting large AI capacity to OpenAI and others.

companies.name: Apple
companies.summary: Runs its own data centers for iCloud and Siri, including large sites in North Carolina, Arizona, Nevada and Oregon, plus capacity leased from others.

companies.name: OpenAI
companies.summary: The AI lab behind ChatGPT. Through the Stargate venture with Oracle and SoftBank it is anchoring several multi-gigawatt U.S. campuses, starting in Abilene, Texas.

companies.name: xAI
companies.summary: Elon Musk's AI company. Built the Colossus supercomputer in Memphis in months, and is building Colossus 2 nearby.

companies.name: Anthropic
companies.summary: AI lab that trains on capacity from cloud partners and has announced its own U.S. data center build-out with partners.

companies.name: CoreWeave
companies.summary: GPU cloud provider that leases AI-ready halls from developers and builds its own, serving AI labs and hyperscalers.

companies.name: Crusoe
companies.summary: Developer and AI cloud that built the first Stargate campus in Abilene and is planning large energy-first campuses such as Cheyenne, Wyoming.

companies.name: Lambda
companies.summary: GPU cloud for AI developers, expanding into its own AI factory sites.

companies.name: Applied Digital
companies.summary: Builds high-density AI campuses in North Dakota, leased to GPU clouds such as CoreWeave.

companies.name: Nvidia
companies.summary: Makes the GPUs and rack-scale systems most AI data centers are designed around. Its rack power figures drive cooling and power design.

companies.name: Vantage Data Centers
companies.summary: Wholesale developer building hyperscale campuses, including Frontier in Shackelford County, Texas, and the Lighthouse Stargate site in Wisconsin.

companies.name: QTS Data Centers
companies.summary: Blackstone-owned developer with large campuses in Atlanta-area Georgia, Virginia, Texas and the Midwest.

companies.name: Digital Realty
companies.summary: One of the largest data center REITs, with big campuses in Northern Virginia, Dallas, Chicago and Silicon Valley.

companies.name: Equinix
companies.summary: The biggest interconnection and colocation provider. Its Ashburn campus is one of the busiest internet exchange points in the world.

companies.name: Aligned Data Centers
companies.summary: Developer of adaptive hyperscale campuses in Texas, Virginia, Arizona, Illinois and Ohio.

companies.name: CyrusOne
companies.summary: Developer and operator owned by KKR and GIP, with campuses across Texas, Arizona, Ohio and Virginia.

companies.name: Switch
companies.summary: Operator of very large campuses in Las Vegas, Reno, Atlanta and Grand Rapids.

companies.name: STACK Infrastructure
companies.summary: Wholesale developer with campuses in Northern Virginia, Dallas, Atlanta, Chicago and Portland.

companies.name: Compass Datacenters
companies.summary: Builds standardized hyperscale campuses, including large sites in Texas, Virginia, Georgia and Mississippi.

companies.name: Related Digital
companies.summary: Digital infrastructure arm of Related Companies, developing the Stargate campus in Saline Township, Michigan.

companies.name: SoftBank
companies.summary: Lead financial partner in Stargate, developing sites such as Lordstown, Ohio and Milam County, Texas.

companies.name: Blackstone
companies.summary: Owner of QTS and AirTrunk and one of the largest investors in data centers and the power behind them.

companies.name: Fermi America
companies.summary: Developing Project Matador near Amarillo, a private grid campus combining gas, nuclear and solar for up to 11 GW of data centers.

companies.name: Tallgrass
companies.summary: Energy infrastructure company partnering with Crusoe on a gas-powered AI campus near Cheyenne, Wyoming.

companies.name: Talen Energy
companies.summary: Owner of the Susquehanna nuclear plant in Pennsylvania, which supplies power to an adjacent Amazon data center campus.

companies.name: Constellation Energy
companies.summary: Largest U.S. nuclear operator, signing long-term power deals with hyperscalers, including restarting Three Mile Island Unit 1 for Microsoft.
